subject: Multi-cloud marketplace footprint & co-sell readiness — proposed playbook
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace planning: ask on cloud-specific SKUs & regions

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the pilot last quarter — CloudBridge is ready to start a broader marketplace push and our GTM lead asked me to get aligned on how Redwood wants to present packaged offers across AWS/Azure/GCP. Specifically: which SKUs should we list per cloud, which regions to prioritize for co-sell enablement, and whether packaging (metered SaaS vs reserved capacity vs private offer) should differ by cloud.

High-level asks:
- Suggested initial SKU names and short descriptions (we'll use these for listing pages).
- Must-have regions for launch (US/EU/APAC triage).
- Any add-on SKUs (compliance, premium SLAs) recommended for marketplace presentation.

Can you send a short matrix or playbook we can use to brief our marketplace ops team? If useful we can do a 30-min sync next week.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge Inc.
elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.com

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace planning: ask on cloud-specific SKUs & regions

Elena — great to hear. Attaching a concise playbook and a footprint matrix (see attachments). High-level proposal below; happy to iterate.

Attachment stubs: marketplace_footprint_matrix.xlsx (matrix: SKUs x clouds x regions), co-sell_readiness_checklist.pdf (vendor-level prerequisites per cloud).

Proposed packaging (concise):
- Entry (hosted): "redwood-hosted-basic" — multi-tenant hosted API, per-token pricing. Fastest listing path for all clouds; recommended initial regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1.
- Scale (dedicated): "redwood-dedicated-standard" — reserved GPU pools / Dedicated. SKU appears as "ReservedCapacity (monthly)" with capacity tiers (S/M/L). Target AWS eu-west-1 + us-west-2, Azure westus2, GCP europe-west4 for predictable customers.
- Private (VPC/on-prem assisted): "redwood-private-premium" — private control plane + VPC connectivity. Only list as "private offer" on GCP and AWS initially; Azure listing possible but requires additional legal review.
- Add-ons: "compliance-pack" (SOC2+HIPAA evidence), "enterprise-sla" (99.95% + 24/7 support).

Cloud-specific notes:
- AWS: Marketplace supports both SaaS listings and private offers. Co-sell motion is strongest when we have a SaaS listing + active ISV co-sell engagement. Recommend listing hosted + dedicated as separate SKUs; start in us-east-1 / eu-west-1. AWS requires pricing on listing (we provide per-token tiers and an annual reserved capacity SKU).
- Azure: Microsoft prefers a single SaaS offer with metered plans. To unlock co-sell we must map SKUs to MPN/offer ids and ensure monthly billing harmonizes with MS commerce. Start with westus2 (US) and northeurope (EU). Expect a slightly longer lead time for co-sell approval.
- GCP: Marketplace favors private offers for enterprise deployments; public SaaS is possible but co-sell is less mature. Recommend private offer flow for Private SKU and hosted SaaS in us-central1 and europe-west4 for parity.

Next steps:
1) Internal review from Soojin and Karthik on marketplace constraints and legal redlines.
2) Finalize SKU names and short descriptions (I propose the strings above).
3) Send finalized matrix back to CloudBridge and schedule partner ops sync (30 min).

If you want, Marissa can own the marketplace ops call cadence.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace planning: ask on cloud-specific SKUs & regions

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 11:02, dylan_brooks@redwood.com wrote:
> Elena — great to hear. Attaching a concise playbook and a footprint matrix (see attachments). High-level proposal below; happy to iterate.

Quick notes from ops/legal perspective (high level):
- Azure: we should avoid >3 metered tiers on the public listing — long tail billing reconciliation with Microsoft gets messy. Map the "Scale (dedicated)" SKU as an "Enterprise Reserved" plan with contract-backed billing. Also need to register offer under the organization's MPN id — Karthik can sync with MPN ops.
- AWS co-sell: to maximize co-sell credit, ensure we attach the "co-sell enablement" checklist items: security questionnaire answers (SOC2 artifact link), recorded demo, customer references in the region. Our "co-sell_readiness_checklist.pdf" includes the specifics.
- GCP private offers: require PO/contract to be attached to the private offer listing; ops will generate quotes once the SKU mapping is locked.

Recommendation: include a small "compliance-pack" SKU as an add-on (fixed price monthly) that we can list uniformly across clouds — simplifies procurement conversations.

Action items: Karithik, can you validate MPN mapping and draft the Azure offer skeleton? Marissa, please own scheduling the partner ops sync and invite Elena + AWS/GCP reps. I can take the co-sell checklist and populate customer-reference asks.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@cloudbridge.com>, AWS Marketplace Co-sell <aws-mktplace-team@amazon.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@gcppartners.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized playbook & next steps (action items + timeline)

Elena / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on internal feedback we've finalized the initial footprint decisions and next steps below. Please reply if anything blocks your ops team.

Agreed SKUs & initial regions (final):
- redwood-hosted-basic (SaaS) — AWS: us-east-1, eu-west-1 | Azure: westus2, northeurope | GCP: us-central1, europe-west4
- redwood-dedicated-standard (Reserved Capacity) — AWS: us-west-2, eu-west-1 | Azure: westus2 (Enterprise Reserved) | GCP: europe-west4 (private offer)
- redwood-private-premium (Private Offer / VPC) — AWS: us-east-1 (private offer) | GCP: us-central1 (private offer) | Azure: allowed but "private offers" require additional procurement review.
- compliance-pack (add-on) — listed across clouds as a fixed monthly add-on.

Timeline & owners:
- Today (D+0): Share finalized matrix (attached) with CloudBridge ops — Dylan / Marissa (owner).
- D+2: Karthik to provide Azure offer skeleton + MPN mapping.
- D+5: Soojin to populate co-sell readiness items and required artifacts for AWS/GCP.
- D+7: Partner ops sync to align on invoicing & private offer flow (Marissa schedule).

Related links and artifacts:
- Playbook (Drive): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_marketplace_playbook
- HubSpot (CloudBridge account): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CloudBridge

Elena — if you can confirm the partner ops contact list and your preferred sync windows, we'll lock the meeting. After the sync we'll produce the exact listing descriptions and pricing strings for each cloud.

Cheers,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com
